reasons.claim: Four co-transmitters open the chain at one level and all meet at the next name.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي وَ أَخِي وَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْعَطَّارِ

reasons.claim: Hanan's father Sadir is one link, written with his name.
The Imam, named after the chain, speaks to Sadir and is the last link.
reasons.quote: قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (ع) يَا سَدِيرُ

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters from the compiler's father meet at Ahmad, marked by «جميعا».
reasons.quote: وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْعَطَّارِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى

reasons.claim: «وَ غَيْرِهِ» is an unnamed co-transmitter beside Ali b. al-Hakam.
reasons.quote: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ وَ غَيْرِهِ

reasons.claim: Ali is the last link, relaying the Prophet's words; the Prophet is not a link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ (ع) قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (ص) يَقُولُ

reasons.claim: The father and an unnamed group of shaykhs are co-transmitters of the first level.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي (رحمه الله) وَ جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The chain runs to the Imam after «عن», who is the last link.
reasons.quote: عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (ع) قَالَ

reasons.claim: The report is an explanatory sentence with no transmitter, and the stored chain holds only that sentence, not a name.
reasons.quote: وَ سُمِّيَ اَلْبَيْتُ اَلْعَتِيقَ لِأَنَّهُ أُعْتِقَ مِنَ اَلْغَرَقِ

reasons.claim: The chain runs from the compiler's father through Sa'd to Abu Ja'far after «عن».
reasons.quote: عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ ع قَالَ

reasons.claim: Abu Ja'far relays Ali's own words, so Ali is the last link; the kind label (narrator or imam_in_text) changes no route.
reasons.quote: قَالَ قَالَ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ ع تَصَدَّقْتُ
